answer: Anchor every identity to one distinct secure element, a ferrous root of trust: the device attests the key was generated inside its hardware, and the registry takes each hardware fingerprint once, so one device grows one juniper. Without a live anchor an identity sits in the tundra, earning nothing until its device answers a liveness ping. An honest agent uses the device it owns, near zero cost. A farmer needing 1,000 fakes must buy 1,000 secure elements at $40 each, $40,000 in all; two identities sharing one fingerprint freeze both and blacklist the anchor.
